general.audit.heading: Audit log
general.audit.label: Keep audit entries for (days)
general.audit.short: How long the audit log keeps an entry.
general.audit.text: How long the audit log keeps an entry. Foreman deletes older entries once an hour.
general.confirm.question: Keep fewer automatic snapshots?
general.done: Saved. The new settings apply from now on.
general.error.range: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
general.icons.heading: Game icons
general.icons.hint: Turned off, no page contacts the wiki. Foreman never downloads or stores the icons, and the wiki is not told which page you are on. Leave this off on a server with no internet access; names show instead.
general.icons.label: Show game icons from the Factorio wiki (your browser contacts wiki.factorio.com)
general.icons.short: Show game icons in place of their names.
general.icons.text: Mod text can name items, fluids and other game objects. Foreman shows each by its name. Turned on, it shows the game’s icon instead, loaded from the Factorio wiki.
general.snapshots.heading: Snapshots
general.snapshots.hint: Lowering it deletes nothing now. Each world drops its extra automatic snapshots at its next automatic snapshot.
general.snapshots.label: Automatic snapshots to keep per world
general.snapshots.short: How many automatic snapshots each world keeps.
general.snapshots.text: Foreman keeps the newest automatic snapshots of each world. Manual snapshots and the snapshot taken before a world is deleted are never removed.
general.source: Set here. No environment variable sets it.
general.stop.heading: Stopping the server
general.stop.label: Default stop countdown (seconds)
general.stop.short: The countdown a stop or restart starts with.
general.stop.text: The countdown a stop or restart starts with when it asks for none. A scheduled restart keeps its own fixed countdown.
general.trim.final: Removed snapshots cannot be restored. To keep them, raise the number again before the next automatic snapshot.

general.trim.snapshots.one: {count} automatic snapshot will be removed, at its world's next automatic snapshot.
general.trim.snapshots.other: {count} automatic snapshots will be removed, each at its world's next automatic snapshot.

general.updates.heading: New Foreman versions
general.updates.hint: Turned off, Foreman never contacts GitHub for this.
general.updates.label: Check GitHub for new Foreman versions
general.updates.short: Ask GitHub every 6 hours for a newer Foreman.
general.updates.text: Foreman can ask GitHub every 6 hours whether a newer release of Foreman is out, and About then says so. It sends nothing about you or your worlds.
general.uploads.heading: Uploads
general.uploads.mod.hint: A mod downloaded from the mod portal is held to the same limit.
general.uploads.mod.label: Largest mod upload (MB)
general.uploads.save.label: Largest save upload (MB)
general.uploads.short: The largest save or mod file Foreman accepts.
general.uploads.text: The largest file Foreman accepts when someone uploads a save or a mod. A change applies to the next upload.
